parsed.visual_overview: A split-screen video call format. The top half features a 3D animated female AI teacher against an abstract background. The bottom half shows an Indian man driving a car, interacting with her. The ad concludes with an app install prompt for Supernova AI.

scenes.script_native:
Miss Nova says: Where are you going?
Rahul says: I go to home.
Miss Nova says: (warmly) आपका मतलब है, "I am going home".
Rahul says: Yes, I am going home. I am very hurry.
Miss Nova says: "I am in a hurry" is the correct way to say that.
Rahul says: Okay, thank you.
